'''Sword Squadron''' was a [[Walker/Legends|walker]]-equipped squadron that was part of the [[Order of Revan]] forces during [[3637 BBY]]. Sword Squadron Walkers 1 and 2 were trying to stop a Coalition strike team from reaching the [[Temple of Sacrifice]], but were unsuccessful and were destroyed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sword Squadron Walkers 1 and 2 appear in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
